banneret.summary: A knight-errant Fighter who leads from the front, healing, steadying and rallying allies around the banner.

Knightly Envoy.summary: Cast Comprehend Languages as a Ritual only (CHA). Learn one language, swappable after a Long Rest for one you met in the last 24 hours. Gain one of Insight, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

options.name: Comprehension
options.summary: Comprehend Languages as a Ritual only, with CHA as the spellcasting ability.

options.name: Polyglot
options.summary: One extra language; after a Long Rest you may trade it for a language you heard, read or saw signed in the past 24 hours.

options.name: Well Spoken
options.summary: Proficiency in Insight, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

Group Recovery.summary: When Second Wind heals you, up to CHA modifier allies (min 1) in a 30-ft Emanation each regain 1d4 + Fighter level HP. Once per Short or Long Rest.

Team Tactics.summary: Allies you pick for Group Recovery gain Advantage on D20 Tests until your next turn starts.

Rallying Surge.summary: On Action Surge, up to CHA modifier allies (min 1) in a 30-ft Emanation may each use a Reaction to make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, or move half their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

options.name: Attack
options.summary: Make a single weapon attack or Unarmed Strike.

options.name: Move
options.summary: Move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Shared Resilience.summary: Reaction when an ally you see within 60 ft fails a save: spend an Indomitable use so it rerolls with a bonus equal to your Fighter level, keeping the new roll.

Inspiring Commander.summary: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge reach a 60-ft Emanation, and you're immune to Charmed and Frightened.

options.name: Bolstered Rally
options.summary: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge use a 60-ft Emanation.

options.name: Unshakable Bravery
options.summary: Immune to the Charmed and Frightened conditions.
